en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

Overseas research and communication planning: Supported ZUS Coffee new-product research using Malaysian audience preferences, social feedback and competitor communication. Distilled product messages into culturally relevant content themes.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through planning, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel coordination and review: Supported online product launches and FamilyMart communication with promotional assets, store information and schedules. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ reviews to improve subsequent content, contributing to 11k+ account follower growth.

Event communication: Coordinated university product presentations and trials, prepared demonstrations, teaching cases and FAQs with product and business teams, and checked publicity information and on-site messages. Handled event organization, trial guidance and questions, and proposed 10 improvements for subsequent pilots.

Information collection and communication support: Classified 100+ community feedback items from teaching, lesson preparation and self-study scenarios in mainland China and overseas. Summarized audience concerns and common questions to improve communication.

Content writing and case organization: Built the product WeChat account from scratch and published 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases. Turned teaching applications into product stories and reusable communication materials; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Cross-border coordination: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation through English communication, needs documentation, responsibilities and agreement handoff.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Brand information and communication planning: Turned product updates, user cases and technology events into clear audience-facing stories. Supported publicity copy, FAQs and event preparation, coordinating factual checks with product, design and operations teams before online publication and offline demonstrations.
Media monitoring and AI analysis: Tracked industry coverage, competitors and user comments. Used AI to create a lightweight analysis dashboard and summarize key information and communication issues.

Writing and media materials: Produced 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts around product updates, use cases and technology events. Supported initial press-release and media-material drafts, organized facts and visuals, checked brand messages and coordinated creator reviews and publication.

Publication coordination and review: Coordinated channel requirements, assets, schedules and revision feedback. Tested headlines, cover images and copy; registrations during the campaign increased 50% versus the prior period, while first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: 2027 Master of Marketing candidate with working English, overseas study and Southeast Asia brand internship experience; external writing, communication execution and cross-cultural collaboration.
Communication: initial press-release drafts, media materials, story planning, factual checks, brand-message consistency and event communication.
AI: analysis dashboards, copy drafts, information summaries and data reviews; SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Analysis: Excel, SPSS, SQL (basic); coverage and user-feedback summaries and communication reviews.
Content: Xiaohongshu, Instagram, WeChat, Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic).
Collaboration: working English, cross-cultural coordination and events; Feishu, DingTalk and Linear for materials and publication tasks.
